title: Eva Live Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Eva Live Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 14, 2026, disclosing entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with Maxim Group LLC permitting the company to sell up to $100,000,000 of common stock through at-the-market offerings. The company will pay a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds and has registered the offering under an S-3 registration statement effective March 24, 2026.
key_points: Eva Live Inc. entered into an Equity Distribution Agreement (EDA) with Maxim Group LLC on April 14, 2026
The EDA permits sale of common stock with aggregate offering price up to $100,000,000
Sales will be conducted at-the-market through Nasdaq Capital Market or in privately negotiated transactions
Commission rate is fixed at 3.0% of aggregate gross proceeds
Company may instruct agent not to sell if price is below specified minimum
Net proceeds intended for working capital and general corporate purposes
